messages:
rachel: RFC follow-up: propose a minimal rollout metadata surface so SDKs can safely handle pin changes. fields: schema_version, lineage, provenance, immutability_level (hard|soft|ephemeral), migration_window_seconds, compat_hints (flat list), and an optional signed rollback_token. keep parsing resilient.

omar: Agree on minimalism. For compat_hints prefer short tokens like "tok:v2" instead of nested maps. Also recommend default immutability by channel: release->hard, canary->soft.

lee: Ops notes: migration_window_seconds must map to cache TTLs and to the resolver's remap window. Emit telemetry events: migration.started, migration.finished, migration.forced_rollback with tenant+model tags.

rachel: Backcompat: server only sets schema_version=2 when new fields are present; older clients ignore unknown fields and treat missing fields as legacy (hard). We'll include unit tests that parse v2 with older parsers.

omar: Playbook draft: 1) announce migration 14 days prior for release tenants; 2) offer opt-in conversion API for hard->soft; 3) require explicit consent for private deployments.

lee: Security: rollback_token must be control-plane signed (v1 signature scheme) and SDKs should validate signature before honoring automatic rollbacks. If missing, fall back to manual operator path.

rachel: Action items: omar update RFC with exact field names and examples; lee add telemetry hooks and signature verification spec; rachel draft tenant notice templates. Revisit next arch sync.
